answer: At the harbor, every agent must moor a crystal beacon carved from local shale before trading. Step one, the harbor master hands each newcomer one shale block. Step two, the agent spends six hours cutting it into a crystal key with a unique fracture pattern. Step three, inspectors scan the fracture and record it in the ledger; step four, fakes are smashed and their owners barred. Forging 10,000 identities means cutting 10,000 crystals: 60,000 GPU-hours, $180,000 in power, and 10,000 distinct machines. A sybil flood is a harbor of painted shale: it crumbles at the first touch of real water.
